bottleneck_analysis.confirmed_bottleneck: Arithmetic throughput: nibble extraction (bit shifts + masks + int-to-float) + f32 scale application (d*sc*dot - dmin*m*sum) per Q4K block
bottleneck_analysis.next_lever: dp4a (4 int8 MACs per instruction) replacing scalar f32 FMA; requires 4-element packing with same scale — compatible with the existing Q8_1 + mini-warp infrastructure
